title: 第十二章 尸鬼封尽第十三章 初遇照美冥
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
看着卡卡西将冥帝带走，水门才是可以放下心，认真和九尾一战。
“这恐怕是我们最后一次战斗了。”水门站在蛤蟆文太头顶之上，缓缓的道。
“水门！不管你做什么，我挺你！”蛤蟆文太抽着烟，严肃道。
“谢谢！”水门点了点头，接着看向了自己怀中那哭泣的孩子，长长的叹了口气“在你没出生前，我就已经用自来也老师小说中的人物给你取好了名字，鸣人！我以后看不到你的成长了，我多希望你可以成为你哥哥冥帝一样的忍者！鸣人.....现在我就做出我人生最大的一次决定！”
看着那凶残的九尾，水门神色淡漠了起来！
文太此时扔掉手中的烟斗，认真了起来，抽出腰间的短刀，“水门，注意了！”
文太快速的跳跃，在接近九尾的时候，高高跃起，手中的短刀成圆弧型划过！看着眼前的短刀，九尾不屑用尾巴卷住，同时剩余的几条尾巴狠狠的扫向文太，庞大如山的文太，竟被九尾的一击，扫出数里之远。
“可恶！”稳住身形的问题又再次跳起，口中开始酝酿，“水遁――铁炮弹！”
一连数个水炮冲向九尾，而九尾只是轻描淡写的喷出几个大火球就将它们化解！
“可恶，完全被压制了啊！”水门皱起眉头。短短数个回合，就看出了文太与九尾的差距。
“难道没有什么办法了吗！”水门慎重的站在文太的头上，接连的几个回合，让水门看出了九尾的实力，“看来真的只有用那招了，可是现在九尾受到的伤害这么小，就算是那招也没有十分的把握封印九尾啊！”
九尾仍旧在蹂躏着木叶的忍者。木叶的忍者，也仿佛不要命的冲向九尾，以自己的微薄之力，消耗着九尾的精力。
“该死的人类我要杀光你们。”九尾咆哮着，九条尾巴一挥，九条火柱分别砸向文太和波风水门。
文太飞快跳起躲开了四道飞来的火柱，同时波风水门使用瞬身术与向他飞来的火柱擦身而过。
这时异变突起，无数的查克拉球从九尾的身上飞起，在九尾的面前飞速凝结着。
文太大惊失色道：“不好九尾在压缩查克拉，快阻止它！”
波风水门连忙召集剩余会水遁的忍者，合力释放忍术。
“尾兽玉”一颗黑色的小圆球在九尾面前形成了，九尾一口将其吞到肚里。接着九尾就像气球一样膨胀起来，赤红色的光线隐隐约约从九尾的嘴中露出。
一滴冷汗从波风水门额头滑落。“所有会土遁的忍者，再去筑一道墙。快！”
“水遁水龙卷。”众忍合力释放的忍术终于完成，一条张牙舞爪的水流巨龙朝九尾冲去！一定要击中啊！在场的忍者共同默念着。紧张的气氛使空气都凝固了。

“嗡。”刺耳的轰鸣声划破了所有人的希望，赤红色的光柱从九尾的口中喷出，与水龙缠在了一起，刺眼的光芒照亮了整个天空。众忍释放的水龙逐渐淹没在光柱里，接着光柱撞碎了第一道土墙，接着第二道、然后是来不及躲闪的忍者、房屋、街道……凡是所过的一切都变成了飞灰。
“鸣人，爸爸只有拿你来作为九尾的人柱力了。爸爸相信你有那样的实力去忍受痛苦和折磨，勇敢的活下去，最后完美的掌控九尾的力量，去和那个人战斗。”
“鸣人，只有完美的掌控了九尾，才有实力去和那个人叫板。你就是木叶未来的希望之子，爸爸也相信你会成功了。原谅爸爸这次给你带来的伤害，记住，爸爸会一直看着你成长！”
水门开始结印，一种死亡特有的气息开始弥漫，看着阴暗的气息，三代震惊了，那是，死神的气息，强大的让人不敢仰视。
“我唯一所希望的就是…就是你能坚强的活下去！还有冥帝，我相信你可以创造出一个时代的神话”
“封印术――尸鬼封禁！”
冥王出现在了波风水门的身后，如同看蝼蚁一般的看着波风水门，“是你把我召唤出来的吗？你有什么需要我完成的吗？你应该知道自己要付出的代价。”
波风水门点点头，指了指还在发怒的九尾。
冥王淡淡的看了一眼九尾，波风水门“飞雷神”之术，到了九尾身上，蛤蟆文太也紧紧抓住了九尾，此时死神大手一招，九尾的灵魂就离开的躯体，九尾感受到了死亡的威胁，它努力的挣扎，可是永远也不能够挣脱。
波风水门除去了九尾灵魂里面一半的嗜血、暴躁、愤怒的一面，把剩下的阳性查克拉封印进了鸣人的肚中。带着自己的灵魂和剩下的九尾查克拉消失。
可恶，站在山顶的宇智波带土突然跪在了地上，嘴中猛烈的吐出几口鲜血，一只手紧紧地摸着自己疼痛无比的右眼，“不愧是....我的老师。”说完，斑自己就用空间忍术消失了，这一次，宇智波带土的身体受了非常严重的伤，估计要几年的时间才能够把伤养好。
“水门老爸！”看着消失的九尾，卡卡西怀中的冥帝再也忍不住大叫一声，疯了般一把推开卡卡西的手，向水门的方向奔去。
“冥帝！”卡卡西立刻追了上去。却惊讶的发现冥帝身上冒出了一股黑色阴冷的气息，冥帝右眼的数字从一到六，不停轮流旋转了起来，此时的冥帝，具有着令人毛骨悚然的气息。
“咚！”冥帝感觉身体越来越无力，最后晕倒在了地上。那冰冷的气息也慢慢隐去了。
天阴沉沉的，没有一丝光亮。繁华的木叶村，此时也静默在小雨之中。空气中弥漫着悲伤，与沉痛。
离去的不单单是四代，波风水门。
玖辛奈则因产后虚弱再加上尾兽被抽以及伤势过重，最终夫妻二人携手共赴黄泉……
墓地里站满了人，清一色的黑衣。为了自己的战死的家人，朋友。或哭泣，或默然。静的有些可怕，就连哭泣声，也是拼命压低了的。
尽管死亡人数实在多不胜球，但是人们都十分自觉的站在一个墓前。为着葬在墓中的英雄默哀，祈祷。
因为，此地埋葬的是拯救了木叶的英雄，木叶的金色闪光――第四代火影！波风水门！还有他的妻子。

“呜.........呜呜”此时，却响起了一声音、声婴儿的哭啼声，一个一手抱着婴儿，一手捧着花的孩子缓缓走了过来！
所有忍者主动让开！

content_en:
After watching Kakashi take Hades away, Minato could relax and seriously fight the Kyuubi.
"I'm afraid this is our last battle." Minato said slowly, standing above Gamabunta's head.
"Minato! No matter what you do, I support you!" Gamabunta said seriously, smoking a cigarette.
"Thank you!" Minato nodded, then looked at the crying child in his arms, and let out a long sigh. "Before you were born, I had already named you after a character in Mr. Jiraiya's novel, Naruto! I won't be able to see you grow in the future. How I wish you could become a ninja like your brother Hades! Naruto... Now I will make the biggest decision in my life!"
Looking at the ferocious Kyuubi, Minato's expression became indifferent!
At this time, Bunta threw away the pipe in his hand, became serious, and pulled out the short knife from his waist, "Minato, pay attention!"
Bunta jumped quickly, and when he was close to the Nine-Tails, he jumped up high and slashed the short sword in his hand in an arc! Looking at the short sword in front of him, Kyuubi didn't bother to wrap it up with his tail. At the same time, the remaining tails swept towards Bunta fiercely. The huge mountain-like Bunta was swept several miles away by the blow of Kyuubi.
"Damn it!" The question of stabilizing his body came up again, and he began to brew in his mouth, "Water Escape - Iron Cannonball!"
Several water cannons rushed towards Kyuubi, but Kyuubi simply sprayed out a few fireballs to resolve them!
"Damn it, I was completely suppressed!" Minato frowned. In just a few rounds, the gap between Bunta and Kyuubi was evident.
"Is there no other way?" Minato stood cautiously on Bunta's head. Several rounds in succession allowed Minato to see the strength of the Kyuubi. "It seems that the only way to use it is to use that move. But now that the damage to the Kyuubi is so small, even that move is not very sure to seal the Kyuubi!"
The Kyuubi was still ravaging the shinobi of Konoha. The ninjas of Konoha also rushed towards Kyuubi as if desperate, using their own meager strength to consume Kyuubi's energy.
"Damn humans, I'm going to kill you all." Kyuubi roared, and with a wave of its nine tails, nine pillars of fire hit Bunta and Namikaze Minato respectively.
Bunta quickly jumped up to avoid four fire pillars flying towards him. At the same time, Namikaze Minato used the teleportation technique to pass by the fire pillars flying towards him.
At this time, a sudden change occurred, and countless chakra balls flew up from Kyuubi's body and condensed rapidly in front of Kyuubi.
Wen Tai was shocked and said: "It's bad that the Nine-Tails is compressing chakra, stop it quickly!"
Namikaze Minato quickly summoned the remaining ninjas who knew water escape and worked together to release the ninjutsu.
"Tailed Beast Jade" A small black ball formed in front of Kyuubi, and Kyuubi swallowed it in one gulp. Then Kyuubi inflated like a balloon, and a red light faintly emerged from Kyuubi's mouth.
A drop of cold sweat slipped from Namikaze Minato's forehead. "All ninjas who can escape, build another wall. Quick!"
"Water Release Waterspout." The ninjutsu released by all the ninjas was finally completed, and a giant water dragon with teeth and claws rushed towards Nine Tails! It must hit! The ninjas present chanted silently together. The tense atmosphere made the air freeze.
"Buzz." The ear-piercing roar shattered everyone's hopes, and a crimson beam of light erupted from Nine-Tails' mouth, entangled with the water dragon, and the dazzling light illuminated the entire sky. The water dragons released by the ninjas were gradually submerged in the light pillar, and then the light pillar smashed the first earth wall, then the second one, and then the ninjas who had no time to dodge, the houses, the streets... everything they passed turned into fly ash.
"Naruto, dad can only use you as the Jinchuuriki of the Nine-Tails. Dad believes that you have the strength to endure pain and torture, live bravely, and finally control the power of the Nine-Tails perfectly to fight that person."
"Naruto, only by perfectly controlling the Nine-Tails can you have the strength to challenge that person.. You are the son of hope for the future of Konoha, and dad also believes that you will succeed. Forgive me for the hurt Dad has caused you this time, and remember, Dad will always watch you grow! "
Minato began to form seals, and a unique aura of death began to permeate the air. Looking at the dark aura, Sandai was shocked. It was the aura of the god of death, so powerful that people dared not look up.
"The only thing I hope for is... that you can survive strong! And Emperor Hades, I believe you can create the myth of an era."
"Sealing Technique—Ghoul Seal! "
Pluto appeared behind Namikaze Minato and looked at Namikaze Minato like an ant, "Did you summon me? Is there anything you need me to accomplish? You should know the price you are paying. "
Namikaze Minato nodded and pointed at Kyuubi, who was still angry.
Pluto glanced at Kyuubi indifferently. Namikaze Minato's "Flying Thunder God" technique reached Kyuubi, and Gamabunta also grabbed Kyuubi tightly. At this time, the god of death made a big move, and Kyuubi's soul left the body. Kyuubi felt the threat of death. It struggled hard, but could never break free.
Namikaze Minato removed half of the bloodthirsty, violent, and angry side of Kyuubi's soul, and sealed the remaining positive chakra into Naruto's belly. Disappeared with his soul and remaining Nine-Tails chakra.
Damn it, Uchiha Obito, who was standing on the top of the mountain, suddenly knelt on the ground, spitting out a few mouthfuls of blood violently from his mouth, and touched his painful right eye tightly with one hand, "As expected of...my teacher. "After saying that, Madara himself disappeared using space ninjutsu. This time, Uchiha Obito's body was very seriously injured. It is estimated that it will take several years to recover from the injury.
"Dad Minato! "Looking at the disappearing Kyuubi, Hades in Kakashi's arms couldn't help but screamed. He pushed Kakashi's hand away like crazy and ran towards Minato.
"Underworld Emperor! "Kakashi immediately chased after him. However, he was surprised to find that a black and cold aura came out of Hades Emperor's body. The numbers in Hades Emperor's right eye kept rotating from one to six. At this time, Hades Emperor had a creepy aura.
“Boom! "Underworld Emperor felt his body getting weaker and weaker, and finally fainted on the ground. The cold breath also slowly disappeared.
The sky was overcast and there was no light. The bustling Konoha Village was also silent in the light rain. The air is filled with sadness and sorrow.
It wasn't just the fourth generation who left, Namikaze Minato.
Kushina was weak after giving birth and the tailed beast was whipped and seriously injured. In the end, the couple went to hell together...
The cemetery was full of people, all dressed in black. For the family and friends who died in the war. Either crying or silent. The silence was a bit scary, and even the crying was suppressed with all his strength.
Although the death toll was overwhelming, people stood in front of a tomb very consciously. Silence and prayer for the heroes buried in the tombs.
Because buried here is the hero who saved Konoha, the golden flash of Konoha - the Fourth Hokage! Namikaze Minato! And his wife.
"Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooothing things""Woohoo" At this time, there was a sound of babies crying, and a child holding a baby in one hand and a flower in the other slowly walked over!
All ninjas take the initiative to get out of the way!
